title: Resolve each required axis to linked, excluded or a reasoned gap
preconditions: Use accepted refund/deadline criterion, one current UX link, one current UI exclusion and one stale implementation link with reason source content digest changed.

steps.action: Project all six required axes for the criterion.
steps.expected_result: Exactly one linked, one excluded and four gaps; linked cells have links, excluded cells have current exclusion, every gap has reasons.
It is a gap with stale state, one stale pin and the original digest-change reason.

expected_result: Each criterion/axis obligation is explicit and every missing obligation is explained.
